contentHtml:
New Delhi: Lupin Ltd on Wednesday said it has received approval from the US health regulator for sitagliptin and metformin hydrochloride tablets used to treat type 2 diabetes.

The company has received approval from the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) for sitagliptin and metformin hydrochloride tablets in strengths of 50 mg/500 mg and 50 mg/1,000 mg, Lupin said in a regulatory filing.

Lupin's product is bioequivalent to the reference listed drug, Janumet Tablets of Merck Sharp and Dohme LLC, it said.

Sitagliptin and metformin hydrochloride tablets had an estimated annual sales of USD 439.2 million in the US, according to IQVIA MAT September 2026 data.

Source : PTI
